purpose: 24 Distinct Cinema World, Production Design, Lighting, Lens & HUD Archetypes to eliminate single-template repetition across Top1 productions.
anti_clone_law: Never reuse the same archetype_id, staging_topology, or palette_family in two consecutive productions on the same channel, or across more than 1 in 4 consecutive studio productions unless explicitly requested by the user.

hud_philosophies.H0_PURE_CINEMA: Zero persistent HUD badges, zero callout boxes, zero top pills. Story told 100% through diegetic camera, blocking, focus, light, and optional clean subtitles.
hud_philosophies.H1_DOCUMENTARY_LOWER_THIRD: Restrained BBC/Lemmino-style minimal serif/sans lower-third location/date stamp for 2.5s on scene entry only; completely clean frame thereafter.
hud_philosophies.H2_DIEGETIC_IN_WORLD: Measurements, labels, and scale markers exist physically inside the 3D space (chalk marks on slate, etched ruler on steel, painted depth markers on concrete wall) moving with true 3D parallax.
hud_philosophies.H3_FORENSIC_BLUEPRINT: Precision tracked thin leader lines + micro-mono data tags reserved strictly for anatomical/mechanical proof shots (<35% of runtime).
hud_philosophies.H4_KINETIC_TEST_SPLIT: Synchronized physical test clock / split-lane comparison bar anchored cleanly at top or divider line during side-by-side experimental runs.
hud_philosophies.H5_EDITORIAL_CHAPTER_CARDS: Bold full-bleed or negative-space typographic chapter/question beats between pure-cinema sequences (Vox / Johnny Harris / Kurzgesagt editorial rhythm).

archetypes.lighting_ratio: 2.5:1 soft directional window key through blinds/curtains + warm wood bounce
